text:
Ivy L: Random idea  minibars & micro snacks show-and-tell next Thursday at 4pm? bring one tiny thing from a trip or hotel minibar. low effort. :mini_bar:
Marc T: Love it. quick heads-up: label allergens and prep time (instant / 5-10m / needs heat). saves confusion.
Zoe: For people flying through ZRH, the bakery near Gate E has warm pretzel bites that are usually ready-to-go. <5 min if you're lucky.
Omar: YVR quick rec: Grab a bannock or smoked salmon roll from the Indigenous food stall near International arrivals. filling and fast.
Priya S: DXB tip: avoid the food court if you have <40 min. the kiosks by Concourse A (shawarma stands) tend to be quicker.
Ivy L: Also: hotel minibars are hilarious for novelty but overpriced. bring the tiny local candy rather than unopened minibar stuff. people like stories more than value.
Marc T: St Pancras train station hack: the little sandwich counter by platform 7 does wrapped sandwiches in under 6 minutes. good for Eurostar transfers.
Zoe: SIN airport rec: laksa cups in the transit hall are surprisingly quick and warm. carry-on friendly if sealed.
Omar: LAX note: if youre tight, prioritize kiosks with visible staff prepping (not the apps). Wings & fries stalls often move faster than sit-down bakeries.
Priya S: Also can we include a "travel story" 1-liner on the sign so people know why you picked it? makes the swap more fun.
TacoBot: :taco: Poll created: "Swap focus: novelty minibar candies / airport quick eats / train-station snacks" (react to vote)
Ivy L: I'll set up the sheet: columns: origin, vendor, 3-ingredient list, allergens, prep time, travel story. will pin and set reminder.
Marc T: Warning anecdote: once brought a minibar chocolate that was actually filled with chili (hotel mislabel)  labeled it "surprise" and people still loved it. proceed with caution. :sweat_smile:
Zoe: I'll bring mini pretzels from ZRH and mark them nut-free.
Omar: i'll bring a small sample of bannock and a note about where to find the smoked salmon stall at YVR.
Priya S: tagging folks who travel a lot @TacoBot please remind folks Wednesday 3pm.
Ivy L: 4pm next Thursday in the kitchen island. food sharing etiquette: small portions, labels, no double-dipping. see you then!
